title: Beyond Capture Go
intro: Capture Go ends at the first capture. In a full game, play continues after a capture. Connected stones share their empty neighbours, called liberties.

steps.instruction: Add a stone that extends the black group. Look at its shared liberties.
steps.hint: An empty crossing directly beside the group joins it.
steps.explanation: Touching stones of the same colour form one group. The whole group shares its liberties.

steps.instruction: Which white group can you capture now? Count its liberties.
steps.hint: Put your cursor on the white stone and look at where the ring is.
steps.explanation: The white stone comes off. It goes into your prisoner pile for counting at the end.

steps.instruction: Try placing Black inside the white ring.
steps.explanation: That move is refused. Your stone would have no liberties, and it would capture nothing.

steps.instruction: White is now surrounded too. Try playing in the same empty point.
steps.hint: It is legal this time. Ask yourself what is different.
steps.explanation: This move captures White. Removing those stones gives your new stone liberties, so the move is allowed.

outro: Next, look at how a full game finishes.
